review_type: Independent read-only review of the sealed extension protocol before execution

checks.score: Unchanged sum of per-fixture median complete-cycle times; at least 2 percent reduction independently required for new-six and pooled-nine cohorts
checks.fixture_guard: Unchanged AND rule: fixture median regression greater than 3 percent and paired regressions greater than 3 percent in a strict majority, minimum two; at least 4/6 new pairs or 5/9 pooled pairs

interpretation.classification: Outcome-triggered protocol amendment for a bounded engineering acceptance decision
interpretation.rationale: The written program specifies at least three repetitions, not a fixed maximum. D028 provides a measurement-instability rationale without erasing the original failed cumulative cohort. The sealed amendment requires corroboration in both the new and pooled cohorts and terminates after this extension.
limitations: The extension was chosen after observing the initial failure and favorable diagnostic evidence; it is not an untouched confirmatory trial.
Passing the engineering guard does not prove general absence of a real river regression.
This audit verifies the protocol and recorded inputs, not the execution or results of the subsequently launched runs.
No cold-start, arbitrary-tree, deployment or universal hardware performance claim follows from this protocol review.
The protocol script_sha256 field was not independently matched to an execution-script file in this audit. Execution conformance and script provenance remain for the terminal results audit.

actions.artifact_preservation: This new review file records the completed pre-execution audit; the 12 serial runs were already active when preservation was requested.
